pages.text: INFLUENCER AGREEMENT. This Agreement is entered into between Brand X and Creator. Creator agrees to deliver one (1) Reel and one (1) TikTok post. Payment terms: NET 75. Brand may unilaterally extend the term of this Agreement for an additional 90 days. Creator grants Brand a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use the content in any media now known or hereafter devised. Exclusivity: Creator shall not promote any competing fitness brand for 6 months following publication.
Approval process: Brand approval required, with 4 rounds of revisions. Creator agrees to refrain from any public conduct that brings disrepute to Brand or its affiliates.
